[P1] 毛毛虫童书馆
姚媛 文
马得 图
东郭先生
新蕾出版社

[P4] 马得 (1919-2007)
原名高马得，江苏南京人，著名国画家。1978年
《三打白骨精》彩墨连环画在联合国教科文组织亚洲中心举办的儿童读物插图评奖会上获儿童读物首画奖。
2004年7月，《马得昆曲画集》获国家新闻出版署等部门颁发的最美图书奖和插图金奖，被作为国礼赠送给第28届世界文化遗产大会。2006年7月，马得昆曲戏画艺术馆落户苏州中国昆曲博物馆。

[P5] 东郭先生
马得 图
姚媛 文

[P6] 东郭先生是私塾里的教书先生，春日里的一天，他骑着小毛驴到野外游玩，不知不觉间迷了路。

[P7] 突然，一只狼跑到他跟前，哀求道：“先生，猎人在追我，求求你救我一命吧！”，

[P8] 狼可怜巴巴的，东郭先生心软了，他想了想，打开书袋让狼钻了进去。

[P9] 猎人们追上来了，问道：“这位先生，你可曾看见一只狼从这边经过？”，

[P10] 东郭先生摇摇头说：“狼？没有啊，我什么也没看见。”说完，就骑着小毛驴慢悠悠地离开了。

[P11] 走出很远后，东郭先生回头看看，看不见那些猎人了。于是，他把狼从袋子里放了出来。

[P12] 东郭先生骑上小毛驴打算离开，狼一口咬住他的衣襟，一副可怜巴巴的样子，
说：“先生，你救人救到底，我要饿死了。”

[P13] 东郭先生听罢，从怀里掏出一张大饼。狼摇摇头，露出一丝狡猾的微笑，说道：“我不吃饼，我只吃肉！”

[P14] 东郭先生看看毛驴，问狼：“你是想吃驴肉吗？”狼看了看小毛驴，说：“先生，驴肉又糙又老，一点也不好吃。”

[P15] 小毛驴越听越害怕，趁着一人一狼说话的功夫，赶紧溜走了。

[P16] 狼说道：“有一种肉，又香又甜，那就是——你的肉！”东郭先生大吃一惊：“狼啊狼，你怎么能这么忘恩负义，没良心呢？”

[P17] 狼哈哈大笑说：“良心是什么？能吃吗？”说着，它朝东郭先生扑了过去，眼看就要把他扑倒在地。

[P18] 东郭先生大叫救命！这时，猎人已经走远了，小毛驴也溜走了。真是叫
天天不应，叫地地不灵。

[P19] 东郭先生对狼说：“你若这么吃了我，我的怨气会让你肚子疼的。不如我们找三个人问，如果大家都认为你该吃我，我就让你吃。”

[P20] 一人一狼向前走，碰到了一棵老桃树。东郭先生说了事情的经过，让桃树评理。

[P21] 老桃树闭上眼睛，遥想当年。那时她还年轻，孩子们吃她的果子，在树上嬉戏，可现在她老了，再没孩子来理她。

[P22] 老桃树说：“该吃，该吃！人是最忘恩负义的。”狼听了真高兴，东郭先生听了，又害怕又生气。

[P23] 一人一狼继续走，碰到了一头老牛。东郭先生又把经过讲了一遍，希望老牛能帮他做主。

[P24] 老牛闭上眼睛，遥想当年。那时她还年轻，人们总来挤她的奶。现在她老了，再也没有奶的时候，就要被拉去宰了吃。

[P25] 老牛说：“该吃，该吃！人是最忘恩负义的。”
狼听了哈哈大笑，迫不及待地要把东郭先生扑倒。东郭先生一边躲，一边说：“说好要问三个人的，你不可说了不算！”

[P26] 一人一狼又往前走，遇到了一位老农夫。东郭先生哭诉了一遍自己的遭遇，伤心地问道：“老伯啊，狼该不该吃我？”

[P27] 老农夫听完道：“我不信，这么小的袋子，狼怎么能钻进去呢？”狼听了急忙说：“怎么不能？我钻给你看。”说完急忙钻进了书袋。

[P28] 狼一钻进去，老农夫就一把攥住袋子，两下三下把袋子捆了起来。

[P29] 老农夫对东郭先生说：“先生，人跟狼，没什么道理好讲的。”说完，就举起锄头朝袋子打下去。

[P30] 狼还剩一口气的时候，老农夫把它从袋子里拖了出来。东郭先生见了，又开始心软，对老农夫说道：“老伯，不要再打了。”

[P31] 这时，一个妇人边哭边跑过来，说她的孩子被狼拖走吃掉了。

[P32] 东郭先生这才恍然大悟，原来狼是真吃人的。他举起锄头，两下三下打死了狼。
full_text_en:
[P1] Mao Mao Chong Children's Book Library
Yao Yuan, text
Ma De, illustrations
Mr. Dongguo
Xinlei Publishing House

[P4] Ma De (1919-2007)
Originally named Gao Ma De, from Nanjing, Jiangsu, he was a renowned Chinese painter. In 1978, his colored ink comic strip "Three Strikes Against the White Bone Demon" won the Best Illustration Award for Children's Books at a competition held by UNESCO's Asia Center.
In July 2004, "Ma De's Kunqu Opera Painting Collection" won the National Most Beautiful Book Award and the Gold Award for Illustration, issued by the State Press and Publication Administration and other departments, and was presented as a national gift to the 28th World Heritage Conference. In July 2006, the Ma De Kunqu Opera Painting Art Museum was established at the China Kunqu Opera Museum in Suzhou.

[P5] Mr. Dongguo
Ma De  Illustrations
Yao Yuan  Text

[P6] Mr. Dongguo was a teacher at a private school. One spring day, he rode his little donkey to the countryside for a trip, and before he knew it, he got lost.

[P7] Suddenly, a wolf ran up to him and pleaded, "Sir, hunters are chasing me. Please save my life!"

[P8] The wolf looked pitiful, and Mr. Dongguo softened. He thought for a moment, then opened his book bag and let the wolf crawl inside.

[P9] The hunters caught up, and asked: "Sir, have you seen a wolf pass by here?"

[P10] Mr. Dongguo shook his head and said, “Wolf? No, I didn’t see anything.” Then, he rode his little donkey away slowly.

[P11] After walking a long way, Mr. Dongguo looked back and saw that the hunters were gone. So, he took the wolf out of the bag.

[P12] Mr. Dongguo mounted his little donkey, intending to leave, when the wolf bit his robe with one bite, looking pitifully, 
said: "Sir, save a person completely, I'm going to starve to death."

[P13] Mr. Dongguo, upon hearing this, took out a large pancake from his pocket. The wolf shook its head, revealing a sly smile, and said: "I don't eat pancakes, I only eat meat!"

[P14] Mr. Dongguo looked at the donkey and asked the wolf, "Are you thinking of eating donkey meat?" The wolf looked at the little donkey and said, "Sir, donkey meat is coarse and old, not delicious at all."

[P15] The little donkey grew more and more frightened, and took the chance while the man and the wolf were talking to quickly run away.

[P16] The wolf said, "There is a kind of meat, fragrant and sweet—that is—your meat!" Mr. Dongguo was greatly shocked: "Wolf, how could you be so ungrateful and heartless?"

[P17] The wolf laughed and said, "What is conscience? Can it be eaten?" Saying that, it lunged at Mr. Dongguo, about to knock him to the ground.

[P18] Mr. Dongguo screamed for help! At this moment, the hunters had already gone far away, and the little donkey had also run off. It was truly a case of crying to heaven with no response, crying to earth with no answer.

[P19] Mr. Dongguo said to the wolf: "If you eat me like this, my resentment will make your stomach ache. Instead, let's find three people to ask. If everyone thinks you should eat me, then I'll let you eat me."

[P20] The man and the wolf walked forward and encountered an old peach tree. Mr. Dongguo explained what had happened and asked the peach tree to judge the matter.

[P21] The old peach tree closed her eyes, reminiscing about the past. Back then, she was young, and children ate her fruits and played in her branches. But now that she is old, no children come to visit her anymore.

[P22] The old peach tree said: "Eat him, eat him! Humans are the most ungrateful." The wolf was delighted to hear this, while Mr. Dongguo felt both afraid and angry.

[P23] The man and the wolf continued walking and met an old ox. Mr. Dongguo recounted the story again, hoping the old ox could help him make a decision.

[P24] The old cow closed her eyes and recalled the past. When she was young, people always came to milk her. Now that she is old and no longer gives milk, she will be taken away to be slaughtered and eaten.

[P25] The old ox said: "Eat him, eat him! Humans are the most ungrateful." 
The wolf laughed heartily and eagerly tried to pounce on Mr. Dongguo. Mr. Dongguo dodged while saying, "We agreed to ask three people, you can't go back on your word!"

[P26] The man and the wolf continued walking forward and met an old farmer. Dongguo Mr. cried out his misfortune and asked sadly, "Old man, should the wolf eat me?"

[P27] The old farmer replied, "I don't believe it. How could a wolf fit into such a small bag?" The wolf hurriedly said, "Why not? I'll show you." And then quickly crawled into the book bag.

[P28] As soon as the wolf went in, the old farmer grabbed the bag and tied it up in two or three quick moves.

[P29] The old farmer said to Mr. Dongguo, "Sir, there's no point in arguing with a wolf." Then he raised his hoe and struck down at the bag.

[P30] When the wolf still had a breath left, the old farmer dragged it out of the bag. Dongguo saw this and softened again, saying to the old farmer, "Old man, don't hit it anymore."

[P31] At this moment, a woman ran over crying, saying her child had been dragged away and eaten by the wolf.

[P32] Mr. Dongguo finally realized, the wolf really does eat people. He raised his hoe and killed the wolf in two or three blows.

[P1] 本页为绘本《东郭先生》的封面，展示了书名、作者信息及一位骑着黑驴的古代人物插图。
[P2] 本页为纯色渐变背景，呈现灰、蓝、白等色调的水彩晕染效果，无任何文字或图像内容。

[P4] 本页介绍了著名国画家马得（1919-2007）的生平与成就，包括其代表作《三打白骨精》获奖、《马得昆曲画集》获国家级奖项并作为国礼赠送，以及其艺术馆落户苏州昆曲博物馆等信息，左侧配有其肖像照片。
[P5] 本页为绘本《东郭先生》的标题页，以卷轴形式展示书名及作者信息，标明马得负责插图，姚媛负责文字。
[P6] 东郭先生骑着小毛驴在春日里到野外游玩，不知不觉间迷了路。
[P7] 东郭先生骑着毛驴时，一只狼突然跑到他面前，哀求他救命，称猎人在追捕它。
[P8] 东郭先生看到狼可怜巴巴的样子心生怜悯，于是打开书袋让狼钻了进去。
[P9] 猎人们追上东郭先生，询问是否见过一只狼从这边经过，画面中狼正惊慌逃跑。
[P10] 东郭先生在猎人询问后否认见过狼，并骑着小毛驴慢悠悠地离开。
[P11] 东郭先生走远后确认猎人已不见，便将藏在袋中的狼放了出来。
[P12] 东郭先生骑着小毛驴准备离开，狼咬住他的衣襟，装出可怜的样子，请求他继续施救。
[P13] 东郭先生拿出大饼想喂狼，狼却拒绝并表示只吃肉，显露出狡猾的本性。
[P14] 东郭先生怀疑狼想吃驴肉，狼则假装嫌弃驴肉难吃，表现出狡猾的本性。
[P15] 小毛驴因害怕东郭先生与狼的对话，趁机悄悄溜走。
[P16] 狼向东郭先生露出真面目，声称要吃他的肉，东郭先生惊愕地指责狼忘恩负义。
[P17] 狼嘲笑东郭先生的善良，声称良心不能吃，随即扑向他，准备将他扑倒在地。
[P18] 东郭先生被狼扑倒后惊恐呼救，但猎人已走远，小毛驴也已溜走，他陷入孤立无援的境地。
[P19] 东郭先生被狼扑倒后，提出让狼找三个人来评判是否该吃他，以拖延时间。
[P20] 东郭先生和狼一起向前走，遇到一棵老桃树，东郭先生向桃树讲述事情经过，请求它评理。
[P21] 老桃树回忆起年轻时孩子们在树上玩耍、吃果子的快乐时光，如今却因年老而无人理睬，显得孤独落寞。
[P22] 老桃树认为人忘恩负义，支持狼吃掉东郭先生，狼因此高兴，东郭先生则又害怕又生气。
[P23] 东郭先生和狼继续前行，遇到一头老牛，他向老牛讲述事情经过，希望老牛能为他主持公道。
[P24] 老牛回忆起年轻时被人们挤奶的时光，如今年老无奶，即将被宰杀，流露出对人类忘恩负义的无奈与悲伤。
[P25] 老牛认为人忘恩负义，支持狼吃掉东郭先生，狼大笑并准备扑向他，东郭先生一边躲避一边强调要遵守三人评判的约定。
[P26] 东郭先生和狼继续前行，遇到一位老农夫，东郭先生向他哭诉遭遇，并询问狼是否该吃他。
[P27] 老农夫对狼能钻进书袋表示怀疑，狼为了证明自己，急忙钻进了书袋。
[P28] 狼钻进书袋后，老农夫立即抓住袋子并迅速将其捆紧，准备处置狼。
[P29] 老农夫认为人与狼无法讲理，举起锄头朝装着狼的袋子打下去，准备处置狼。
[P30] 狼被老农夫从袋中拖出，东郭先生见状心软，请求老农夫不要再打狼。
[P31] 一个妇人哭着跑来，声称她的孩子被狼拖走吃掉了，画面中老农夫正拖着受伤的狼，东郭先生在一旁观看。
[P32] 东郭先生意识到狼确实会吃人，于是举起锄头将狼打死。
